description: Defines the Git::Repository class responsible for querying and modifying a specific Git repository, including operations like commit, stage, merge, rebase, checkout, remote management, and conflict handling.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: Represents a Git repository with methods for querying state, managing commits, branches, tags, remotes, and performing operations like merge, rebase, checkout, push, pull, and reset.

methods.name: Repository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repository with a given path.

methods.name: isHeadDetached
methods.description: Checks if HEAD is in detached state.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the repository.

methods.name: hasConflicts
methods.description: Checks if the repository is in a conflict state.

methods.name: isInNormalState
methods.description: Checks if the repository is in a normal state (not merge, rebase, etc.).

methods.name: isInMergeState
methods.description: Checks if a merge is in progress.

methods.name: isInRebaseState
methods.description: Checks if a rebase is in progress.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the given message.

methods.name: stage
methods.description: Stages files specified by relative paths.

methods.name: unstage
methods.description: Unstages files specified by relative paths.

methods.name: getStagedFiles
methods.description: Returns list of files in the index.

methods.name: getDirtyFiles
methods.description: Returns list of modified but unstaged files.

methods.name: getConflictedFiles
methods.description: Returns list of files with conflicts.

methods.name: hardReset
methods.description: Resets the repository to HEAD, discarding local changes.

methods.name: abortRebase
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing rebase.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Creates a tag at current HEAD or specified commit.

methods.name: branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch at current HEAD or specified commit.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes to remote repository with optional credentials callback.

methods.name: pull
methods.description: Pulls updates from remote with optional credentials callback.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches updates from remote with optional credentials callback and reflog message.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Checks if a remote with given name exists.

methods.name: hasRemote
methods.description: Checks if a remote is configured.

methods.name: addRemote
methods.description: Adds a remote with specified URL and name.

methods.name: getRemote
methods.description: Returns the remote object associated with the repository.

methods.name: stash
methods.description: Saves current work and index state into a stash with optional message.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges a branch into current HEAD.

methods.name: numOfRemainingRebasePatches
methods.description: Returns count of remaining rebase patches.

methods.name: startRebase
methods.description: Starts rebase onto specified branch.

methods.name: applyNextRebasePatch
methods.description: Applies the next rebase patch.

methods.name: commitCurrentRebasePatch
methods.description: Finalizes the current rebase patch.

methods.name: deleteTag
methods.description: Deletes specified tag.

methods.name: deleteBranch
methods.description: Deletes specified branch.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Checks out a commit or branch, updating working directory and HEAD.

methods.name: getParentCommits
methods.description: Returns parent commits of a given commit.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns list of tags in repository.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Returns list of branches.

methods.name: isCheckedOut
methods.description: Checks if a commit or branch is currently checked out.

methods.name: isABranchCheckedOut
methods.description: Checks if HEAD is on a branch.

methods.name: getHeadBranch
methods.description: Returns the current branch HEAD points to, or nullptr if detached.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the current commit HEAD points to.

methods.name: isOwnedByRepo
methods.description: Checks if an object (commit, branch, tag, remote) belongs to this repository.
